description: The bar chart, titled "Factual Errors," compares the number of factual errors across four different question-answering systems—HotpotQA, 2WikiMQA, MuSiQue, and IIRC—under three distinct configurations: NoR QA, OneR QA, and IRCoT QA. The horizontal axis lists the four datasets, while the vertical axis, labeled "Factual Errors," ranges from 0 to 40 in increments of 5. Each dataset has a group of three bars, colored yellow (NoR QA), red (OneR QA), and blue (IRCoT QA), with the numerical value of each bar displayed above it. For HotpotQA, the error counts are 15 (NoR QA), 10 (OneR QA), and 5 (IRCoT QA). For 2WikiMQA, the counts are 29 (NoR QA), 23 (OneR QA), and 14 (IRCoT QA). For MuSiQue, the counts are 28 (NoR QA), 27 (OneR QA), and 23 (IRCoT QA). For IIRC, the counts are 15 (NoR QA), 14 (OneR QA), and 11 (IRCoT QA). In all four datasets, the number of factual errors is lowest for the IRCoT QA configuration and highest for the NoR QA configuration.
